Written new, 3,719 lines, sha256 1bbce76a472321b7292094ace526089bb226689ea6528661281f4b0fe63fe87c. Standard library only at import time; the record writer in frozen/provenance.py is imported inside a function, and the dynamics engine only inside a worker script that the program writes at run time on the box. Three parts, each runnable alone against a saved run state: fetch and check (--stage extract), measure (--stage generate), decide (--stage endpoints); --stage all does the lot. Every record carries run_valid in the file itself, not only in the summary; a missed anchor, a failed timer check or broken infrastructure sets it false and it stays false in every record written afterwards. A guard, ceiling or timeout stop does not set it false: it voids the inputs left unmeasured, keeps the finished ones, and stamps every later record with "incomplete run: unmeasured inputs are VOID, not holding". Exit codes: 0 every input decided by measurement, 2 broken infrastructure or harness, 3 guard or ceiling or timeout stop, 4 anchor miss. The stage flow takes its stage functions and tool runner by injection, so the selftest runs every route with stand-in stages. Repeats on the one box are called repeats on one box; no output calls them replication.

Written new, 191 lines, sha256 253ac47c9b8e6faaad958a02f1c70bcdff9b8b41e1a6b001857231e29af23197. Creates an isolated Python environment with the image's own packages still visible, so the preinstalled CUDA build of torch is used and never replaced. Declares the two system packages (aria2, ca-certificates) and hands them to the measurement program. Reads PRICE_USD_PER_HOUR, BUDGET_LEFT_USD and REMOTE_TIMEOUT from the environment, clamps them to USD 5 and 7,200 seconds, works out the stopping point as whichever cap bites first, and records the timeout it saw in env.txt; an unset timeout gives 7200 with the label "REMOTE_TIMEOUT not forwarded; default 7200 used". env.txt lists named non-secret variables only; nothing dumps the environment and nothing reads the key file. Runs the install-and-controls part with the download token present, then unsets HF_TOKEN and HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN before anything else, then the measurement part, then the decisions part, which always runs. Each part runs under an outer stop set 600 seconds before the stopping point; a return code of 124 makes the script stop the recorded tool process groups by group id, write the decisions with --after-timeout, and finish with exit code 3 rather than reporting a failure. Writes results_m4/out/RUN_DONE with the final exit code and is non-zero on any stage failure.
